recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-11187 source edit is needed; future reconsideration of the usefulness or cardinality of primarySource should be handled under the later primarySource issue family, not this DSTU2 reconciliation item.
issue_request: FHIR-11187 asked to replace the DSTU2 Immunization.reported boolean with an informationSource-style element aligned with MedicationStatement. The Published resolution was Not Persuasive with Modification: retain the concept indicating whether an immunization was directly administered and add another attribute for the source of non-directly administered immunization events.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-11187. The relevant historical application appears in commit baf0c978b8, which replaced top-level Immunization.reported with Immunization.primarySource and added Immunization.reportOrigin plus the ImmunizationReportOrigin value set. Commit 8386871f82 later renamed/expanded reportOrigin to Immunization.informationSource[x], preserving the source-of-reported-data concept now present in the StructureDefinition.
additional_context: Immunization is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source defines Immunization.primarySource as the indicator that data originated with the individual or organization responsible for administering the vaccine, and Immunization.informationSource as the source of data when the immunization report is not based on the administering source. Later Published core issue FHIR-37722 reaffirmed this distinction and applied the current primarySource clarification in commit 0f4d89973f.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source no longer has the old top-level Immunization.reported element, has the retained direct/primary-source boolean, and has the separate informationSource element requested by the modified resolution.

related_jiras.note: Later Published core issue clarified the distinction between Immunization.primarySource and Immunization.informationSource and supports the current interpretation of FHIR-11187.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Not Persuasive with Modification PHER issue requested replacing Immunization.reported with informationSource but resolved to retain the direct-administration concept and add a separate source attribute.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes that the correct outcome is a split between a primary/direct indicator and a source-of-reported-data element, not a simple replacement.
